parent_objective: design role-stratified residual semantics and support redesign route
blocked_by: R4 unavoidable mitigation residuals need role-specific semantics
R2/R3/R5 mixed and blocked residuals need support-coverage versus scenario-redesign separation
support policies remain diagnostic bounds and must not be ranked
supersedes: direct training from residual support rows

public_gates: M2323 must freeze R4 mitigation semantics/support redesign requirements
M2323 must freeze R2/R3/R5 coverage-vs-redesign separation requirements
M2323 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel no-oracle actor contract
M2323 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim residual support solved

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the accepted M2321/M2322 residual route split into a frozen non-ranking redesign plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if the design routes directly to training or ranking
stop if R4 mitigation is scored as ordinary obstacle-passage avoidance without mitigation-specific semantics
stop if support policies are treated as ranked controller-family baselines
stop if residual support is claimed solved
fallback_plan: split into R4-only mitigation semantics design if the combined design is too broad
split into R2/R3/R5 coverage-vs-redesign audit if mitigation semantics are already sufficiently specified
route to branch synthesis if design cannot produce a non-ranking implementation plan
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new role-stratified residual redesign branch starts at M2323

admission_evidence: M2321 reports R4 mitigation route count 12
M2321 reports R2/R3/R5 support coverage route count 23 and scenario/support redesign route count 12
allowed_updates: M2323 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: R4 mitigation semantics/support redesign requirements are frozen
an artifact-only implementation route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2323 designs support and metric semantics and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2323; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Residual support gaps must not be interpreted as self-ID failure before role-specific scenario quality is repaired.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: separates residual scenarios by role semantics instead of continuing one narrow support-repair loop
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare a valid current-sim scenario/task-quality basis before controller-family comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2323 cannot select an artifact-only implementation plan
the role-stratified residual branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A role-stratified redesign plan can separate R4 mitigation semantics from R2/R3/R5 support-coverage and scenario-redesign blockers without training or ranking.
success_criteria: the design defines R4 mitigation semantics/support redesign requirements
the design defines R2/R3/R5 coverage-vs-redesign requirements
the design selects one artifact-only follow-up implementation route
failure_criteria: M2323 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2323 ranks support policies or selects a winner
M2323 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2323 cannot select an artifact-only next route

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design from M2321 residual route artifacts and M2322 audit

decision_rule: M2323 passes if it freezes a non-ranking role-stratified residual redesign and selects an artifact-only implementation route.
